description: Irrigation Gravity Pipe (WCORP-292) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Corporation. The Water Corporation layer is a spatial representation of a Irrigation Gravity Pipe. A pipe is a vessel that is used to carry drainage from one location to another. The drainage in the pipe flows by gravitational means. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Corporation. Its tags are Gravity Pipe, Infrastructure, Irrigation, Utilities, Water Corporation. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, pdf. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
